Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 299 as introduced will increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of Revenue, beginning October 1, 2022, by requiring the Department to value and assess ad valorem tax for all airplanes, airships, other aircraft, and will simultaneously decrease the obligations of the county officials, currently charged with valuing and assessing airplanes, airships and other aircraft. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 04/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 299 as passed the Senate will increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Revenue, beginning October 1, 2022, by requiring the Department to value and assess ad valorem tax for all airplanes, airships, other aircraft, and will correspondingly decrease the administrative obligations of the county tax officials, currently charged with valuing and assessing airplanes, airships and other aircraft. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
